blocks.text: All civil service personnel of the Fire and Police Departments shall be paid at the rates prescribed for the position in which they are employed. (Ord. 20206 § 28, 9-10-19. Code 1981 § 31-252. Code 1995 § 106-71. Formerly 2.125.170.)
